items.text: The overall increase in the standard entropy change of the hydrated cations is 148 JK-1 mol-1 (-138 to +10).

items.text: As the decrease in the standard entropy of the hydrated cations is much less than the increase in the entropy of the surroundings, the Group 2 metal sulfates becomeless soluble as you go down the group.
